messages:
maria: quick check — trying to enable a short (2h) capture of webhook requests on staging to debug failing retries. would capture headers + body. can we do that if we scrub tokens and emails? cc @alex

alex: we need exact fields. we must NOT log raw auth tokens or unmasked PII. if you can redact Authorization / X-Vendor-Token headers and hash emails, i'm fine for staging.

maria: payload looks like `{\n  \"user_email\": \"foo@example.com\",\n  \"order_id\": \"ord_123\",\n  \"phone_number\": \"+1-555-1111\"\n}` and headers include `Authorization` + `X-Vendor-Token`.

samir: for debugging, hashing email is reasonable. prefer HMAC/sha256 with a salt stored in KMS rather than plain sha256 — prevents rainbow-table issues. no raw email in logs.

security-bot: Reminder: any capture that includes PII needs explicit approval and retention limits. See policy: https://intra.redwood/security/logging-policy

dev-ops: infra can toggle ephemeral capture; command we use: `logctl capture --service=webhook-processor --duration=2h --output=ephemeral` — we can also set a header filter: `--drop-headers Authorization,X-Vendor-Token`

alex: also add a body scrubber that replaces `user_email` and `phone_number` with hashed values or `REDACTED`. For troubleshooting, hashed_email + first 3 chars visible is ok (`foo***@example.com` pattern) but not raw.

maria: i'll add middleware. pseudo:
```
body.user_email = hmac_sha256(body.user_email, KMS_SALT)
body.phone_number = redact(body.phone_number)
headers.remove('Authorization')
headers.remove('X-Vendor-Token')
```

samir: make sure the HMAC key is rotated afterwards and access is limited. do not log the salt or key ID.

security-bot: Approver list required: legal + infra. tagging @jess and @noah for approval.

jess: fine for a 2h staging capture provided emails are one-way hashed and tokens scrubbed. approve. :white_check_mark:

noah: infra ok. i'll run the `logctl` command and ensure retention/auto-delete 2h. will also verify S3 object lifecycle if any. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — i'll open a tiny PR with the middleware + logctl command & config, tag @jess @noah for audit trail. will not enable in prod.

alex: ping when PR is ready, i'll do a quick code review.

maria: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webhook-processor/pull/432 — includes tests + scrubber. will merge after approvals and then request infra to run capture.

noah: done running capture, logs will expire at `2418908434`. confirm and close after 24h if everything is good.

maria: closing thread once we verify debug info. thanks everyone! :pray:
